name: Ircon International Ltd
about: Ircon International Limited (IRCON) commenced its business in 1976 as a railway construction company, it diversified progressively since 1985 as an integrated engineering and construction PSU specializing in large and technologically complex infrastructure projects in various sectors such as railways, highways, etc. [1] [2]
keyPoints:
Overview
Incorporated in 1976, Ircon was awarded Mini Ratna Category-I status in 1998 and was elevated to ‘Navratna’ status by the Department of Public Enterprises, Ministry of Finance, in October 2023. In FY24, the Government of India divested 8% stake in the company via an Offer for Sale, reducing its shareholding to 65% as of September 2024[1] [2] [3]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 34.2%
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.469 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 33.0 to 45.1 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -8.01%
